# Test Image Source

**Filename:** construction-site.jpg  
**Source:** Pixabay  
**URL:** https://pixabay.com/photos/construction-site-crane-1391538/  
**License:** CC0 Public Domain / Pixabay Content License  
**Attribution:** Not required (CC0)  
**Description:** Tower crane at construction site with workers

## Usage
This image is used for smoke testing the hazard detection pipeline. It should show:
- Construction workers
- Safety equipment (or lack thereof)
- Potential hazards
- Construction machinery

## Note for Setup
Due to download restrictions, please manually download from the Pixabay URL above
or use any other CC0/public domain construction site image showing workers and equipment.

Alternative sources:
- Unsplash: https://unsplash.com/s/photos/construction-site
- Pexels: https://www.pexels.com/search/construction%20site/
- Pixabay: https://pixabay.com/images/search/construction%20site/

Ensure the image shows potential safety concerns for realistic testing.
